about_the_game:
Age of Empires Mobile: PC Edition combines familiar Age of Empires Mobile elements with an optimized PC experience.

Command civilizations, boost your economy, and outmaneuver rivals with the precision of mouse & keyboard.

Experience exhilarating, rapid pacing with the strategic elements that PC strategy players demand: optimized mouse control and settings, full keyboard navigation, refined UI, and enhanced 4K visuals let you dive into swift and intense battles while forming alliances with hundreds of players to build a dominant empire.

Seamless crossplay lets you swap between PC and Mobile with a single account, while platform integration brings richness to Steam and Xbox Live features that include achievements, social connections, dedicated ranked ladders, and alliances that keep the competitive scene thriving.

EXPERIENCE A NEW AGE OF EMPIRES

• Iconic Age of Empires: Familiar elements from the beloved Age of Empires games merged with brand-new, mobile-specific gameplay – all re-imagined for PC.

• PC-First Controls & Interface: Designed for mouse and keyboard with optimized UI, enhanced 4K visuals, full navigation support, and seamless Steam and Xbox Live integration

COMPETE & COOPERATE WITH FAST, INTENSE GAMEPLAY

• Ranked PvP, co-op, cross-platform multiplayer and alliance ladders with seasonal resets and rewards

• Accessible empire management with quick decision making, accelerated economy and tech trees means full-scale clashes at a rapid pace

STUNNING BATTLEGROUNDS & UNIQUE CIVILIZATIONS

• Realistic 4K graphics, real-time weather, and dynamic destruction

• Select from over 72 epic heroes with synergistic abilities: Legendary figures like Joan of Arc, Leonidas, and Julius Caesar are joined by intriguing new allies such as Miyamoto Musashi, Hua Mulan, and Rani Durgavati.

• Future seasons with new civs and maps for endless fun

CROSSPLAY & CROSS-PROGRESSION

• Seamlessly swap between PC and Mobile with a single account

• Shared global servers keep alliances, chat, and events in sync
